list.name: db_unique_name
list.query: SELECT db_unique_name FROM dpa.db_instance ORDER BY 1

list.name: sql_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT sql_id FROM dpa.v_sql_impact_1h WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::numeric AS samples FROM dpa.ash_sample WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND sample_time >= now() - interval '1 hour'
SELECT count(*)::numeric AS advisories FROM dpa.dpa_advisory WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND advisory_time >= now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT count(*)::numeric AS plan_changes FROM dpa.v_plan_changes_24h WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name'
SELECT count(*)::numeric AS changes FROM dpa.change_event WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND event_time >= now() - interval '7 days'

SELECT con_id, pdb_name, sql_id, plan_hash_value, module, service_name, wait_class, event, active_seconds, impact_score, left(sample_sql_text, 240) AS sql_text_sample FROM dpa.v_sql_impact_1h WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND ('$sql_id' = 'All' OR sql_id = '$sql_id') ORDER BY impact_score DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT advisory_time, severity, category, sql_id, plan_hash_value, module, signal, recommendation, impact_score FROM dpa.v_advisory_queue WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND ('$sql_id' = 'All' OR sql_id = '$sql_id') ORDER BY impact_score DESC, advisory_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT con_id, pdb_name, sql_id, plan_count, first_seen, last_seen, plan_hash_values FROM dpa.v_plan_changes_24h WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND ('$sql_id' = 'All' OR sql_id = '$sql_id') ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT snapshot_time, inst_id, con_id, pdb_name, sql_id, plan_hash_value, parsing_schema_name, module, service_name, executions, elapsed_time_us, cpu_time_us, buffer_gets, disk_reads, rows_processed, parse_calls, left(sql_text, 800) AS sql_text FROM dpa.sql_snapshot WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND ('$sql_id' = 'All' OR sql_id = '$sql_id') ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC, elapsed_time_us DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT snapshot_time, inst_id, con_id, pdb_name, sql_id, plan_hash_value, child_number, id, parent_id, operation, options, object_owner, object_name, object_type, cardinality, cost, optimizer FROM dpa.sql_plan_snapshot WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND ('$sql_id' = 'All' OR sql_id = '$sql_id') ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC, sql_id, plan_hash_value, child_number, id LIMIT 200

SELECT event_time, con_id, pdb_name, source, event_type, object_owner, object_name, object_type, details FROM dpa.v_recent_changes WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT sample_time, con_id, pdb_name, owner, object_name, object_type, metric_name, value FROM dpa.object_stats_snapshot WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND sample_time >= now() - interval '6 hours' ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT con_id, pdb_name, iso_dow, hour_of_day, wait_class, event, avg_samples_per_hour FROM dpa.v_wait_seasonal_baseline WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' ORDER BY avg_samples_per_hour DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT app, tier, db_unique_name, target_db_time_ms_per_call, business_weight, owner, notes FROM dpa.app_slo WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' ORDER BY business_weight DESC, app

SELECT con_id, pdb_name, sql_id, plan_hash_value, last_seen, plan_count, plan_signature FROM dpa.v_plan_diff_24h WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' AND ('$sql_id' = 'All' OR sql_id = '$sql_id') ORDER BY sql_id, plan_hash_value LIMIT 50

SELECT sample_time, inst_id, con_id, pdb_name, category, metric_name, object_owner, object_name, status, value, details FROM dpa.v_oracle_ops_latest WHERE db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' ORDER BY category, metric_name, value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

SELECT s.table_name, s.total_size, s.estimated_rows, coalesce(r.rows_last_hour, 0) AS rows_last_hour, coalesce(r.estimated_rows_per_day, 0) AS estimated_rows_per_day FROM dpa.v_repository_table_size s LEFT JOIN dpa.v_repository_ingest_rate r ON r.table_name = s.table_name AND r.db_unique_name = '$db_unique_name' ORDER BY s.total_bytes DESC
